in_hebrew.name: Greg
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Greg הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Gregory derives from the Greek word 'gregoreo,' meaning 'to watch, to be alert.' As a Christian name, it is derived from the Latin form 'Gregorius,' which means 'watchful, guardian.'

in_latin.name: Gregorius
in_latin.meaning: meaning of Gregorius is derived from Greek words for watchful and awake
in_latin.long_meaning: Gregorius is derived from Greek words meaning watchful and awake, it signifies someone who is vigilant and attentive, a virtue highly valued in Christian tradition, it is also associated with the Greek word meaning to watch or to observe, in early Christian church, the name was given to those who were known for their prayerful and watchful nature, it is a name that reflects the importance of being attentive to the spiritual realm and being vigilant in one's faith, it is a name that has been associated with several saints and martyrs in the Christian tradition
